modeling_decisions: Concept inspected: retain broad bowl-like branching tuft, naked axes and loose lateral capsules. Correct concept root overlength/spreading: root-like axes are about20mm below a compact10mm rhizome, not broad deep modern roots. Correct terminal-dominated concept: place most capsules laterally on short20-40degree stalks with naked axis extending beyond; do not cap every axis like Cooksonia. Flatten capsules, keep subtle reniform notch, no spherical berries or leaves. Approximately40-60 visible fertile axis ends,60-110 capsules and24-32 descending root-like axes are explicit low-poly reductions; source estimated many more. Preserve basal horizontal branching and upper forks. No soil disk.
